scope: Prior art for canonical isomorphism caching and the mathematical transport ingredients; no exhaustive novelty search.

sources.title: Reducing the Number of Fitness Evaluations in Graph Genetic Programming Using a Canonical Graph Indexed Database
sources.authors: Jens Niehaus, Christian Igel, Wolfgang Banzhaf
sources.verified_claim: The paper explicitly maps colored isomorphic graphs to a canonical representative and stores or looks up canonically labeled graphs so an isomorphic prior evaluation can be reused.
sources.implication: Direct prior art rules out presenting canonical-form-indexed graph evaluation reuse as a globally new algorithmic idea.

sources.title: From Invariants to Canonization in Parallel
sources.verified_claim: The paper defines canonical labeling as a complete graph invariant and explicitly extends the notions to colored graphs.
sources.implication: Representing the distinguished unordered terminal pair as a color class is an application of established colored-graph canonization.

sources.title: The Electrical Resistance of a Graph Captures Its Commute and Cover Times
sources.authors: Ashok K. Chandra, Prabhakar Raghavan, Walter L. Ruzzo, Roman Smolensky, Prasoon Tiwari
sources.verified_claim: The paper distinguishes a walk from s to t and back and identifies its expected commute time with 2m times effective resistance.
sources.implication: The commute identity is established prior art; the two one-way hitting quantities remain direction-sensitive.

sources.title: Local Characteristics, Entropy and Limit Theorems for Spanning Trees and Domino Tilings via Transfer-Impedances
sources.verified_claim: Theorem 1.1 gives uniform-spanning-tree edge-set inclusion probabilities as determinants of a transfer-impedance matrix.
sources.implication: Uniform spanning-tree edge marginals and their electrical formulation are established ingredients.

sources.title: Equivariance with Learned Canonicalization Functions
sources.verified_claim: The paper treats canonicalization followed by a prediction function as a general route to equivariance and discusses minima unique only up to the input stabilizer.
sources.implication: It is broad conceptual prior art for canonicalize-compute-transport and tied poses, while its learned ML setting is not direct prior art for this exact graph API.

sources.title: Practical Graph Isomorphism
sources.verified_claim: The retained author-hosted scan is the foundational canonical-labeling reference cited by the direct prior-art paper.
sources.implication: The project's exhaustive least-mask construction is a small-domain canonical labeling implementation, not a new canonization principle.

conclusion.supported_wording: A newly implemented project-specific optimization of the Mathematics Atlas exact-analysis batch workload, assembled from established components.
conclusion.search_limitation: The exact result-dictionary combination was not located, but absence from this bounded source check is not evidence of novelty.
